Create a document with a nonempty title and literal body text.

        body may be empty. folder is an optional nonempty organizational label;
        omit it to use 'default'. A new label is allowed. Markdown and plain text

        its unique id, mock URL, title, body, and folder.

        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

Independent reads, searches, web fetches, and read-only commands should be batched into the same assistant turn — the runtime executes independent calls concurrently, and batching avoids resending the whole conversation on every extra round-trip.

You MUST use your tools to take action — do not describe what you would do or plan to do without actually doing it. arguments.title: Retrospective — EXP-2023-05-expansion-nudge
arguments.body:
# EXP-2023-05-expansion-nudge

- **Final status:** Inconclusive; closed June 29, 2023.
- **Measured result:** At n=372, treatment delivered +$6.10 expansion MRR per account versus control, below the +$8 target. The high-depth slice (3+ integrations and 2+ active admins; n=118) was +$13.20, while the low-depth slice (0–1 integration or only 1 active admin; n=142) was +$0.60. The aggregate did not meet the bar.
- **Rollout decision:** No blanket rollout. The `expansion_nudge_60d_v1` flag was rolled back to 0%; this read is not Expansion Assist validation.
- **Carryforward for Expansion Assist:** Replace the generic day-60 trigger with behavior-based eligibility. Explore prompts for retained-mid accounts showing integration depth, recent active-admin behavior, and credible signs of a usage ceiling; use current account state and suppress commercial prompts when Customer Success adoption or renewal work is active. Treat this as a direction for further bounded learning, not as causal proof or forecast credit.
